description: This Java class converts MockServer HttpResponse objects into Netty HTTP response objects, handling headers, cookies, chunked encoding, and error logging.

classes.name: MockServerHttpResponseToFullHttpResponse
classes.description: A class that maps MockServer HttpResponse objects to Netty FullHttpResponse objects, supporting chunked responses and header/cookie management.

methods.name: mapMockServerResponseToNettyResponse
methods.description: Converts a MockServer HttpResponse into a list of Netty HTTP objects, handling chunked encoding if specified.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the HTTP status from the HttpResponse, defaulting to 200 if not specified.

methods.name: getBody
methods.description: Converts the HttpResponse body to a ByteBuf using BodyDecoderEncoder.

methods.name: setHeaders
methods.description: Sets headers, including Content-Type, Content-Length, and HTTP/2 extension headers, on the Netty response.

methods.name: setCookies
methods.description: Adds cookies from HttpResponse to the Netty response headers.
